philosophy.tagline_id: Tujuh puluh enam rumus, satu ruang kerja, tanpa sambungan internet.
philosophy.one_line_pitch: A scientific desktop utility for quantitative marketing that looks like a 1998 statistics program and behaves like a constraint solver with a curriculum attached.

design_doctrine.name: Understated Instrument
design_doctrine.reference_artefact: G*Power 3.1 by Faul, Erdfelder, Lang and Buchner
design_doctrine.core_claim: The interface should look like it was written by someone who cared about the mathematics and not at all about the marketing of the software itself. The restraint is the signal. A tool that announces its own sophistication invites the user to evaluate the announcement; a tool that says nothing invites the user to evaluate the output.

principles.name: Density over whitespace
principles.rule: Information density is a feature. Controls sit close together the way they do on an instrument panel. Do not add generous padding to make the interface feel modern; the target user is reading numbers, not admiring layout.
principles.concrete: Default control height 22px, vertical gap 4px, group gap 10px.

principles.name: Every pixel is legible at 100 percent zoom
principles.rule: No thin grey text on white. No 11px labels with low contrast. The aesthetic is austere, not delicate.
principles.concrete: Minimum contrast ratio 7:1 for body text, 4.5:1 for disabled states.

principles.name: The output field is the hero
principles.rule: The result region is bordered, monospaced, selectable, and copyable. It is the only element permitted a heavier visual weight than its neighbours.
principles.concrete: Sunken border, monospace 13px, right-aligned numerals, tabular figures.

principles.name: No decoration without function
principles.rule: No hero images, no illustrations, no icon sets, no gradients, no shadows beyond a single-pixel bevel. If a graphic does not carry data or indicate state, it does not exist.
principles.concrete: Total decorative asset budget for the entire application: zero files.

principles.name: Modality is honest
principles.rule: Dialogs are dialogs. They have title bars, an OK button and a Cancel button, and they block. Do not use sliding panels, toasts that vanish, or inline expansion where a decision is being requested.
principles.concrete: Any action that changes stored state uses a modal with explicit confirm.

principles.name: Keyboard first
principles.rule: Every control is reachable by Tab in reading order. Every menu has an underlined mnemonic. The entire application is operable without a mouse.
principles.concrete: Alt+F opens File. Tab order follows the DOM. No focus traps outside modals.

principles.name: The hidden depth rule
principles.rule: The sophistication lives in the engine and in the explanation text, never in the chrome. A user who never opens the Details pane should still get correct answers; a user who opens it should find a full derivation, the provenance of every number, and the assumptions that were made on their behalf.
principles.concrete: Every result carries a derivation trail retrievable in one keystroke (F9).

principles.name: Refuse rather than guess
principles.rule: When the inputs are insufficient or contradictory, the tool states that plainly in the status bar. It never fills a gap with a default and reports the result as if it were computed.
principles.concrete: Underdetermined systems return a named list of missing variables.

principles.name: Print is a first-class output
principles.rule: Scientific utilities are used to produce evidence. Every screen has a print view: black on white, Times New Roman 12pt, A4, justified body text, with formula, inputs, result, assumptions and timestamp.
principles.concrete: Ctrl+P produces a self-contained A4 report with no interface chrome.

principles.name: Offline is the default, not the fallback
principles.rule: The desktop build performs no network requests of any kind. No telemetry, no font CDN, no update check unless the user asks. The web build works fully from cache after first load.
principles.concrete: Desktop build asserts zero outbound sockets in an automated test.

the_humility_paradox.statement: The user has asked for an interface that understates its own capability. This is a rhetorical strategy, and like any rhetorical strategy it fails when it is performed rather than practised.
the_humility_paradox.implementation_rule: Do not write copy that draws attention to the modesty. No text anywhere in the application should say 'simple but powerful', 'deceptively capable', or any variant. The restraint must be structural: plain labels, no adjectives, no exclamation marks, no onboarding tour that explains how clever the tool is. The user discovers the depth by using it.
the_humility_paradox.test: Search the entire string catalogue for the words powerful, advanced, revolutionary, seamless, effortless, and intuitive. The count must be zero.

decision_record.title: Single codebase for web and desktop
decision_record.decision: Build one web application and wrap it with Tauri v2 for desktop.
alternatives_considered: Electron: rejected, 120 MB baseline violates the 30 MB size budget
Separate native Windows app in C# WinForms: rejected, doubles maintenance and the WinForms look can be reproduced faithfully in CSS
Qt with PySide: rejected, packaging Python for a portable exe is fragile
consequences: The Rust toolchain becomes a build dependency
WebView2 is required on Windows; it ships with Windows 10 1803 and later, and the installer must bundle the evergreen bootstrapper for older machines
The portable exe target is achievable at roughly 8 to 14 MB

decision_record.title: The computation engine is a standalone package with no UI dependency
decision_record.decision: Place all formula logic in packages/engine as a pure TypeScript library with zero imports from React, the DOM, or any browser API.
decision_record.rationale: It must be testable in Node, reusable in a future CLI, and verifiable by a reviewer who does not want to read UI code. This separation is also what makes the golden test suite meaningful.

decision_record.title: No runtime formula parsing from strings in production
decision_record.decision: The JavaScript expressions in this specification are authoring input. A build step compiles them into typed functions. The shipped application never calls eval or the Function constructor.
decision_record.rationale: Security, tree shaking, and the ability to type check every formula.

decision_record.title: Local-first storage with SQLite on desktop and IndexedDB on web
decision_record.decision: One storage interface, two adapters. Desktop uses SQLite through the Tauri SQL plugin. Web uses IndexedDB through a thin wrapper. Both serialise to the same portable JSON workspace format.

decision_record.title: Decimal arithmetic for currency, float64 for everything else
decision_record.decision: Currency-class variables use a decimal library to avoid accumulation error in report totals. Ratio and score classes use float64 with explicit rounding at the display layer only.
decision_record.rationale: Rounding at the computation layer is the most common source of numbers that do not reconcile between a dashboard and a spreadsheet.

decision_record.title: Internationalisation from the first commit, not retrofitted
decision_record.decision: No user-visible string is written inline in a component. Every string lives in the locale catalogue with an id and an en value.

engine.overview: The engine is a bipartite graph over variables and relations. Formulas are relations, not functions: each knows how to solve for its output and for each input it can isolate. Propagation is a fixpoint iteration over this graph. This single design decision is what turns a calculator into the tool the user described.

propagation_algorithm.complexity: O(G * R * I) where G is generations, R relations, I average arity. With 76 relations and G bounded at 12, this completes in well under one millisecond.
propagation_algorithm.termination: Guaranteed: each round either adds at least one new variable or breaks, and the variable set is finite.

conflict_detection.problem: A user may supply values that are mutually inconsistent, for example revenue, orders, and an AOV that does not match. Silently overwriting is unacceptable in a tool intended to produce auditable evidence.
conflict_detection.rule: User-supplied values are never overwritten by derivation. When a relation derives a value for a variable the user already supplied, compare them. If the relative difference exceeds the tolerance, raise a Conflict.
conflict_detection.tolerance: relative 1e-6 for ratio classes, absolute 0.005 currency units for money
conflict_detection.conflict_presentation: A modal listing: the variable, the user value, the derived value, the relation that produced the derivation, and the chain of inputs. Three buttons: Keep mine, Use derived, Cancel. Never auto-resolve.

underdetermination.rule: When the user asks for a target variable that propagation cannot reach, do not return an error code. Compute the minimal set of additional variables that would unlock it and name them.
algorithm: Run reverse reachability from the target through the relation graph.
For each relation that could produce the target, compute its missing inputs.
Rank candidate frontiers by cardinality, then by how many other variables each would also unlock.
Return the top three frontiers as human sentences.
underdetermination.example_message_id: Nilai seumur hidup pelanggan belum dapat dihitung. Tambahkan salah satu dari: (1) marjin kotor dan tingkat retensi; (2) pendapatan, harga pokok penjualan, dan tingkat churn.

unit_and_period_discipline.problem: The single most common error in marketing arithmetic is mixing periods: a monthly churn rate with an annual purchase frequency, or a weekly spend with a monthly conversion count.
rules: Every workspace declares a base period. Every count-class and currency-class value is stamped with it.
A relation that combines values with different period stamps is blocked, not silently computed.
The blocking message names both periods and offers the conversion.
Conversions between periods are explicit user actions, recorded in the assumption log.
Rate conversion uses the correct compounding: annual churn is 1 minus (1 minus monthly churn) to the twelfth, never monthly times twelve. The engine must refuse the naive multiplication and say why.

helper_functions.name: series_sum
helper_functions.signature: (retention: number, discount: number, horizon: number) => number
helper_functions.body: sum over t = 1..horizon of pow(retention, t) / pow(1 + discount, t)
helper_functions.note: Closed form available when retention/(1+discount) < 1, but the loop is clearer and fast enough.

helper_functions.name: npv_calc
helper_functions.body: sum over t of cashFlows[t-1] / pow(1 + rate, t), t starting at 1
helper_functions.note: The initial investment is subtracted outside this helper, at period zero, undiscounted.

helper_functions.name: irr_solve
helper_functions.method: Brent's method on [-0.9999, 10] after a sign-change scan at 0.005 resolution
helper_functions.returns: { roots: number[], unique: boolean, converged: boolean }
guards: at least one sign change in the full cash flow series including -investment0
helper_functions.note: Must report every root found. Reporting a single root when several exist is a correctness bug, not a presentation choice.

helper_functions.name: black_scholes_call
helper_functions.helper_needed: Phi, the standard normal CDF, via Abramowitz and Stegun 26.2.17 or an erf-based implementation accurate to 1e-7

helper_functions.name: vw_intersection
helper_functions.method: Build four cumulative curves over the sorted price grid. Optimal price point is the crossing of too-cheap descending and too-expensive ascending. Indifference price point is the crossing of cheap and expensive. Also return the range of acceptable pricing bounded by the marginal cheapness and marginal expensiveness points.
helper_functions.returns: { opp: number, ipp: number, pmc: number, pme: number, curves: Curve[] }
helper_functions.note: This one must always render its curves. Reporting the crossing price without the curves hides the shape that determines whether the crossing is meaningful.

axis_c_classes.structural_signature: error in any factor propagates multiplicatively

matrix_b_by_c.purpose: Shows which mathematical competence each workflow phase actually demands.
matrix_b_by_c.finding_1: Phases B2 through B5 contain no formula above structural class C4. The entire operational middle of marketing can be executed with division and multiplication. This explains why organisations produce thick reports and thin decisions.
matrix_b_by_c.finding_2: Methodological load concentrates at both ends. B0 and B1 hold every C8, C9 and C10 formula; B8 holds every C7. The competence needed at the start and end of the cycle differs in kind, not degree, from the competence needed in the middle.
matrix_b_by_c.finding_3: Phase B7 holds only two formulas. Advocacy is the weakest measured area in the corpus, despite being the only mechanism that lowers acquisition cost structurally.
matrix_b_by_c.software_implication: The Workbench should surface phase coverage: when a workspace has values in B2 through B5 but none in B0 or B8, say so. That gap is the finding.

matrix_a_by_d.finding_d1_has_no_floor: No product decision formula sits below stratum VIII. Product managers have no cheap daily signal in this corpus. Mitigation: cart abandonment and bounce rate per feature may be borrowed as operational proxies, which the software should offer explicitly rather than leaving the user to discover.
matrix_a_by_d.finding_d3_has_no_ceiling: Every media formula stops at stratum VI. Media budgets can be reported but not optimised within this corpus. The only bridge is ROMI in D8, which requires an experimental design that no formula here provides.
matrix_a_by_d.finding_predictive_is_executive: Only D7 and D8 reach tiers C and D. Predictive and prescriptive capability is concentrated in leadership decisions; operational staff work entirely in the descriptive and diagnostic tiers.

redundancy_verdicts.rule_id: Menyajikan keduanya menggandakan ruang tanpa menambah informasi. Pilih satu sebagai angka resmi.
Bentuknya identik dan hanya lingkupnya berbeda. Tetapkan satu sebagai angka resmi lembaga, sajikan sisanya sebagai konteks.
Satu tanpa pasangannya kehilangan daya diagnostiknya. Perangkat lunak harus menampilkan keduanya.
Setiap tingkat harus terlihat. Menyajikan tingkat akhir tanpa tingkat sebelumnya menyembunyikan asumsi.
Koordinat identik namun mengukur lapisan biaya berbeda dan menjawab pertanyaan manajerial berbeda.
Keduanya menghasilkan dua peringkat yang bersaing tanpa mekanisme penyelesaian.

dependency_layers.content: Raw variables entered by the user
Requires at least one L1 output

cross_axis_analysis.governance_implication: Fifty-eight of seventy-six formulas sit at layer one. All error propagation risk concentrates in the remaining eighteen, and all eighteen depend on the same small set of inputs: ARPU, gross margin, CAC, retention rate and NPV. Those five variables are the ones that need a written definition. Everything else can be governed by ordinary reporting convention.
stated_limitations: The axes are not fully orthogonal. Axis A and axis C correlate because methodological sophistication largely expresses itself as mathematical form.
Ten formulas have equally defensible alternative positions on axis D. The classification is arguable at the level of individual formulas while remaining stable at the level of structure.
The corpus contains no direct measure of long-term brand equity. Share of voice and share of search approach it only from the attention side.
The corpus contains no ethical, sustainability or social impact measure. All seventy-six formulas are oriented toward efficiency and financial value.

No formula in the corpus establishes incrementality. ROMI, opportunity score and real options value all presuppose a counterfactual estimate that nothing here provides. This is the most practically felt gap.

design_stance.statement: Gamification here must not fight the interface doctrine. There are no confetti animations, no cartoon mascots, no coloured badges shaped like shields. The game layer is rendered in the same Win32 vocabulary as everything else: segmented progress bars, list views with achievement rows, a status bar counter, and a certificate that prints in black and white.
design_stance.model: The reward structure is borrowed from flight simulator rating systems and from amateur radio licence classes rather than from mobile games. You earn a rating, the rating is printed on a certificate, and the certificate lists what you demonstrated.
anti_patterns_forbidden: Daily streak pressure that punishes absence
Artificial energy or lives that gate practice
Leaderboards comparing individuals by raw XP
Loot boxes or randomised rewards of any kind
Any mechanic that rewards speed over correctness

xp_rules.no_penalty_note: Wrong answers never subtract XP. The cost of a wrong answer is that it resets the mastery streak for that formula, which is consequence enough.
xp_rules.explanation_bonus: +40 percent when the learner also selects the correct interpretation band
xp_rules.audit_bonus: +60 percent for correctly identifying a planted error in a spot-the-error item
xp_rules.no_speed_bonus: There is no time bonus anywhere in the system. Speed is not the skill being taught.
xp_rules.decay: None. Mastery decays through spaced repetition scheduling, not through XP loss.

mastery_model.promotion_rule: A formula moves to mastered after N consecutive correct solves across at least three distinct challenge types, where N is the formula's mastery_threshold_correct_in_row.

review_scheduler.algorithm: SM-2 variant, simplified to four intervals
review_scheduler.on_correct: advance one interval, cap at 35 days
review_scheduler.on_incorrect: return to interval index 0 and set state to practising
review_scheduler.rationale: Full SM-2 with per-item ease factors is overkill for 76 items and produces scheduling the learner cannot predict. Four fixed intervals are legible.

mastery_model.dashboard_render: A ListView with 76 rows: symbol, name, stratum, state, streak, next review date. Sortable by every column. This is the learner's whole progress picture on one screen.

challenge_types.prompt_shape: Given all inputs, compute the result.
challenge_types.generation: Sample inputs from the formula's plausible range, round to realistic precision.
challenge_types.grading: Relative tolerance 0.5 percent, or exact match on integers.

challenge_types.prompt_shape: Given the result and all but one input, find the missing input.
challenge_types.generation: Only for formulas with at least one inverse solution defined.
challenge_types.note: This is the challenge type that actually builds fluency. Weight it heavily in the scheduler.

challenge_types.prompt_shape: A short scenario with a stated calculation containing one planted mistake drawn from the formula's failure_modes list. Identify the mistake.
challenge_types.generation: Pick one failure mode, construct a scenario that triggers it, present the wrong result as if confident.
challenge_types.grading: Multiple choice with four options, one correct, three plausible distractors drawn from other failure modes.
challenge_types.note: This type teaches the thing that actually separates a competent analyst from a spreadsheet operator.

challenge_types.prompt_shape: Given a computed result, choose the correct interpretation and the correct next action.
challenge_types.generation: Only for formulas with interpretation_bands defined.
challenge_types.grading: Single select from the formula's own bands plus one distractor from an adjacent formula.

challenge_types.prompt_shape: A decision situation is described. Choose which of four metrics answers it, and say why the other three do not.
challenge_types.generation: Draw the correct answer from the axis D domain matching the described decision. Draw distractors from the same axis C structural class so they look similar but answer a different question.
challenge_types.grading: Single select plus a free-text justification scored by keyword rubric.
challenge_types.note: The hardest and most valuable type. It is the only one that tests axis D understanding directly.

challenge_types.prompt_shape: Two or three raw values are given. Derive a named target that sits three or more relations away.
challenge_types.generation: Use the propagation engine in reverse to find targets at the desired depth.
challenge_types.grading: Relative tolerance 1 percent on the final target only.
challenge_types.note: Available from rating T4 onward. This is the boss-fight type.

challenge_types.prompt_shape: A fictional dashboard of eight to twelve metrics is presented. Two of them are internally inconsistent. Find them.
challenge_types.generation: Generate a consistent workspace with the propagation engine, then corrupt two values by a detectable margin.
challenge_types.grading: Both must be found. Partial credit at 40 percent for one.
challenge_types.note: Available from rating T7 onward. This is the capstone type and mirrors real professional work.

steps: build the decision tree with three states

badges.generation_rule: One badge per formula, awarded at mastered state, plus the quest badges above, plus the structural badges below.

structural_badges.condition: All C1 class formulas mastered without a single denominator error
Correctly identify the dominant factor in ten sensitivity analyses
All C7 class formulas mastered plus five correct EVPI interpretations

Complete a chain_derivation at depth five or greater

confusable_pairs_drill.purpose: A dedicated drill for the four pairs most often conflated in practice.

pairs.distinction_id: CPA memakai belanja kampanye. CAC memakai seluruh biaya penjualan dan pemasaran.
Yang pertama berbasis jumlah pelanggan, yang kedua berbasis nilai pendapatan.
ROAS berbasis pendapatan kotor teratribusi. ROMI berbasis pendapatan inkremental hasil uji.
ARPU pada strata I dihitung dari data aktual. ARPU dalam rumus TAM adalah asumsi proyeksi.
GDR tidak memuat ekspansi dan tidak pernah melampaui satu. NDR memuat ekspansi dan dapat melampaui satu.
Marjin kotor adalah rasio atas pendapatan. Marjin kontribusi adalah nilai mutlak per unit.
Keduanya memberi peringkat berbeda atas portofolio yang sama. Pilih satu dan pakai secara konsisten.

confusable_pairs_drill.format: Rapid single-select, twelve items, no time limit, full explanation after each.

tauri_conf_highlights.app.security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'none'; font-src 'self'

offline_assertion.requirement: The desktop build performs zero network requests at runtime.
enforcement: No Tauri http plugin in the dependency list
A Playwright test that runs the packaged app with a network interceptor and asserts zero requests
A CI grep step that fails if fetch( or XMLHttpRequest appears anywhere in packages/app/src

portable_build.target: Windows x64 single executable, no installer, no admin rights
portable_build.method: Produce the NSIS build, then also emit the raw executable from the Tauri target directory. The portable executable stores its SQLite database beside itself when the directory is writable, and falls back to the user profile directory otherwise.
storage_probe_order: Directory containing the executable, if writable
In-memory only, with a visible warning in the status bar that progress will not persist
portable_build.why_it_matters: Campus and corporate machines in Indonesia frequently forbid installation. This artifact is the difference between a tool that is used and a tool that is admired and then closed.

data_storage.desktop: SQLite at <storage>/metrika.db via the Tauri SQL plugin

testing.philosophy: A tool whose entire value is numerical correctness must be tested numerically. The golden test suite is not optional scaffolding; it is the product's claim to trustworthiness.

layers.count: 76 files, minimum 4 cases each, 304 cases minimum
cases_required: The worked example from the specification, asserted to a stated precision
A boundary case at the lower edge of the valid domain
A rejection case that must throw a named DomainViolation, for example a zero denominator
A round trip: compute forward, then use each inverse to recover each input
layers.rule: The worked example values in the specification and in the test must be generated from the same source. They cannot drift.

cases: From revenue, orders and users alone, assert that AOV, ARPU and at least four further variables are derived
From impressions, clicks, spend, visitors and conversions, assert at least twelve derived variables
Assert termination within the generation bound on a fully populated workspace
Assert that removing one known value removes exactly the transitive closure of what it produced
Assert that a user value is never overwritten and that a contradiction raises a Conflict
Assert that a period mismatch blocks the relation and produces a named reason
Every formula has exactly one coordinate on each of the four axes
Every input variable id exists in the canonical variable registry
Every output variable id exists in the canonical variable registry
Every inverse expression references only variables in that formula's input set plus its output
No two formulas share the same id
The formula count is exactly 76
Every formula with an interpretation band set has bands that are contiguous and non-overlapping
Every string id in the locale catalogue has both an id and an en value
The forbidden adjective list appears zero times in the locale catalogue
IRR with two sign changes must report both roots and set unique to false
Bass F(t) with p equal to zero must be rejected, not return Infinity
CLV with retention equal to one and discount equal to zero must be bounded by the horizon, not diverge
Break-even with price equal to variable cost must be rejected with a specific message
Black Scholes with sigma approaching zero must approach max(S minus discounted X, 0)
Currency addition across one thousand values must reconcile exactly to the decimal total
Launch, select CTR, enter two numbers, read the correct result
Enter three values in the Workbench, press Derive, assert the derived count is at least twelve
Complete one practice item of each of the seven challenge types
Print preview renders with no interface chrome and uses the serif font
The application is fully operable through one complete calculation using only the keyboard
With the network disabled, every screen still functions
Bevel rendering on raised and sunken controls at 100 percent and 150 percent zoom
The result field uses tabular figures and does not shift width as digits change
Charts render identical numbers to their adjacent tables

Generated files match a fresh generation
Bundle size under the stated budget
No fetch or XMLHttpRequest in application source

claude_code_instructions.how_to_read_this_file: This document is the single source of truth for the project. Treat sections as requirements, not suggestions. Where this document and your own preference differ, follow this document and raise the disagreement in the commit message rather than silently deviating.

operating_rules.rule: Work phase by phase in order.
operating_rules.detail: Do not start a later phase because it seems more interesting. Phases P03, P05 and P06 are hard gates: nothing downstream may begin until their definition of done is met.
If a formula is wrong, fix it in spec/metrika.spec.json and regenerate. CI will catch violations, but catching them late wastes a session.

operating_rules.rule: Write the test before the implementation for anything numerical.
operating_rules.detail: The worked examples in this specification are the test fixtures. Assert them first, watch them fail, then implement.

The reading content for the nine modules is the one large body of prose this specification does not contain in full. Draft it, but present it for review before committing. Do not pad it with generic marketing filler.
If a stated budget cannot be met, say so with the measured number rather than quietly relaxing the budget in the specification.
One commit per task where practical. The commit message names the phase code.

operating_rules.rule: Do not add dependencies without stating the reason.
operating_rules.detail: Every added package must be justified against the bundle budget. The chart module in particular is hand-written on purpose; do not replace it with a library.

operating_rules.rule: The interface doctrine is not negotiable for aesthetic reasons.
operating_rules.detail: If a component looks dated, that is the intended outcome. Do not modernise borders, soften corners, add shadows, or introduce colour to indicate state.

first_session_checklist: Read the philosophy and architecture sections in full before writing code.
Confirm the formula count in the registry is 76.
Confirm the canonical variable count is at least 150.
Scaffold the repository per P00 and get CI green on an empty test suite.
Then stop and confirm the scaffold with the project owner before P01.
known_ambiguities_to_resolve_with_the_ow: Whether the Indonesian interface should use formal or semi-formal register for practice feedback. The specification assumes formal throughout.
Whether a Bahasa Indonesia only build is wanted for classroom use, dropping English to reduce bundle size.
Whether the conjoint module should eventually include estimation from raw choice data, which would require a logit solver and is deliberately out of scope for version one.
The exact institutional attribution to place in the About dialog.
Whether the certificate should carry any institutional mark at all, given the honesty clause.
claude_code_instructions.what_success_looks_like: A student on a five-year-old laptop with no internet opens a single executable from a flash drive, enters three numbers from a campaign report, and sees seventeen other numbers appear with a full derivation for each. Nothing on the screen tries to impress them. They learn the subject because the tool makes the structure of the subject visible.

acceptance_criteria.quality_bar_statement: The product is finished when a sceptical lecturer can open the derivation pane, trace every number back to an input or a stated assumption, and find nothing hidden. That is a higher bar than feature completeness and it is the one that matters here.
